title: Forming and Shaping Simple Components
objective: Understand at theory level why forming and shaping must follow controlled component requirements.
safety_boundary: Theory only; no forming-machine or hazardous shaping instructions.

sections.heading: 1. Form and shape
sections.body: Fabrication may require material to match a specified component form or geometry.

sections.heading: 2. Controlled result
sections.body: The required dimensions and shape come from approved job information.

sections.heading: 3. Material behaviour
sections.body: Material properties influence how fabrication work is planned and controlled.

sections.heading: 4. Practical boundary
sections.body: Actual forming and shaping requires authorised equipment, training and supervision.
